verdicts.reason: A turns the design into a proper left-to-right banner with a strong headline, but the gap between the end of 'sunshine.' and the CTA pill is almost nothing. The subtext column is also squeezed into four centred lines that break badly ('Now in four / flavours.'), and that column hugs the right edge.
